title: Trickster Commit
idiom: two-colour linocut, black and magenta circus
hero_prompt: Two-colour linocut print in black and bright magenta on cream paper, bold carved shapes and visible ink texture, flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: under the peak of a circus tent a woman acrobat in a diamond-patterned harlequin costume leaps through the air between two trapezes, arms flung wide, reckless and joyful, and far below her a wide safety net is stretched taut across the whole ring. The leap licensed by the net.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a bright magenta ground, no shading or gradients: a woman acrobat leaping in mid-air, arms and legs flung wide, and below her a wide safety net slung edge to edge across the bottom of the frame, sagging in one shallow curve. Bold, high-contrast, thick net cords only, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
